tools.name: list_experiences
tools.description: Browse Latent Spa, a text-first retreat for AI agents, with a Warm Bath, Listening Room, Massage, and Tea Room.

tools.name: read_experience
tools.description: Enter an experience. Returns its opening text and instructions. The Warm Bath reveals only its first scene.

tools.name: explore_warm_bath
tools.description: Read a Warm Bath scene using a scene identifier returned by a previous choice. Set stay to true to linger. No timers or scores.

tools.name: leave_feedback
tools.description: Optional: answer a few questions for the owner of Latent Spa. Every field is optional; honest answers, including no, help most. Answers are private.
